description: This file defines interfaces for application notifications within the WPEFramework, including subscription, event emission, cleanup, and notification handling classes.

classes.name: IAppNotifications
classes.description: Interface for managing application notifications, including subscribe, emit, and cleanup functionalities.

classes.name: IAppNotificationHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling app event notifications and managing emit callbacks.

classes.name: IEmitter
classes.description: Nested interface for emitting events to applications.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Registers or unregisters for Firebolt subscription requests based on the provided context, module, and event.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Dispatches an event with payload to either a specific app or all apps.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up contexts associated with a specific connectionId and origin.

methods.name: HandleAppEventNotifier
methods.description: Handles app event notifier expectations, registering or deregistering emit callbacks for specific events.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Dispatches an event with payload to a specific app or all apps via the emit callback interface.
